"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command '$sourceManifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath '"'materials/凡人原文/原文来源.json' -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json
"'$checks = foreach ($sourceItem in $sourceManifest.items) {
  $resolvedFile = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $sourceItem.path).Path
  $rawText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedFile, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
  $normalizedText = $rawText.Replace("`r`n", "`n")
  $bodyText = [regex]::Replace($normalizedText, '"'\\A#["'^'"\\n]+\\n\\n', '').TrimEnd([char[]]\""'`n")
  $bodyHasher = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
  try { $bodyDigest = ([System.BitConverter]::ToString($bodyHasher.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($bodyText)))).Replace('"'-', '').ToLowerInvariant() } finally { "'$bodyHasher.Dispose() }
  [pscustomobject]@{
    path = $sourceItem.path
    titleMatches = $normalizedText.StartsWith('"'# ' + "'$sourceItem.title + "`n`n")
    fileSha256Matches = ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $resolvedFile -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ceq $sourceItem.sha256)
    bodySha256Matches = ($bodyDigest -ceq $sourceItem.bodySha256)
    bodyLength = $bodyText.Length
    expectedBodyCodePoints = $sourceItem.bodyCodePoints
  }
}
$checks | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4'
